snippet.title: Cyclopean: The Great Abyss - Full Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Cyclopean: The Great Abyss has left Early Access!
Get ready to explore the depths of the underworld, align yourself with its strange denizens and experience the challenges of the new, optional Roguelike Mode.

You can purchase or wishlist the game on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2958790/Cyclopean_The_Great_Abyss/

Or get it on Itch too:
https://schmidt-workshops.itch.io/cyclopean-the-great-abyss

And don't forget to check out Psyclopean (who provided the trailer's music)
https://altrusiangrace.bandcamp.com/album/nostalgiamancer
